name: The doer (fāʿil)
definition: The marfūʿ noun that comes after its verb and names the one who did the act, or of whom the act is told.
body: In قَامَ زَيْدٌ, zaydun is the fāʿil. In مَاتَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd died) it is the fāʿil too, though dying is not something he did: the term belongs to grammar, not to acting.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya defines it as the marfūʿ noun whose verb is mentioned before it. It can be a noun you see (قَامَ زَيْدٌ) or a pronoun (قُمْتُ, I stood, where the -tu is the fāʿil).

examples.text: Zayd stood: zaydun is the fāʿil.
I stood: the -tu is the fāʿil.
